name: Ascend G6

Launch.Announced / released: Ascend G6 & G6 4G: 2014-02, Ascend P7 mini: 2014-04-28
Launch.Successor: Huawei Ascend G7, Huawei P8 lite

Body.Other: Proximity sensor, ambient light sensor, accelerometer, compass

Platform.Operating system: Initial: Android 4.3 Jelly Bean + Emotion UI 2 Lite
Platform.CPU: Ascend G6: Qualcomm MSM8X12 Snapdragon 200 (28 nm), 2×1.2 GHz ARM Cortex-A7, Ascend G6 4G & P7 mini: Qualcomm MSM8926 Snapdragon 400 (28 nm), 4×1.2 GHz ARM Cortex-A7

Memory.Storage: Ascend G6: 4 GB, Ascend G6 4G & P7 mini: 8 GB, eMMC 4.5

Display.Display: All models: LCD, 4.5", 960 × 540, 16:9, 245 ppi, Ascend G6 & G6 4G: IPS, Ascend P7 mini: TFT

Cameras.Rear camera: 8 MP Sony IMX134, f/2.0, 1/4.0", 1.12 μm, AF, LED flash, Video: 720p@30fps

Connectivity.Connectivity: microUSB 2.0, 3.5 mm audio jack, Bluetooth 4.0 (A2DP, EDR), NFC, FM radio, Wi-Fi 802.11 b/g/n (DLNA, hotspot), GPS, A-GPS, GLONASS
